svg.title: coverage autonomous agents
svg.desc: Coverage of Non-Deterministic Autonomous Coding Agents. Decompose work into tasks, let a coding agent implement, use quality gates and backpressure, and hand results or blocked work to a human. Bounded retries use memory and context. Related subjects include scheduling, multi-agent orchestration, safety, tooling and troubleshooting.
svg.text: EARLIER VOLUME / AUTONOMOUS WORK BETWEEN HUMAN REVIEWS
Task decomposition, persistent context, quality gates and controlled repetition.
Earlier foundations: autonomous coding loops, quality controls and human handoffs.
